examples/cdk-multilang/local/run-local.s.description: Cross-language no-drift check: Go writes one item, TypeScript and Python read the same shape back, and the generated CDK construct is drift-checked.

examples/basic/todo/main.go.description: Interactive todo CLI; T2 adds a scripted non-interactive transcript with output assertions.

examples/encryption/main.go.description: KMS envelope round-trip; T3 selects a KMS emulator or records the named cloud gap.
